rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care (HDC) - discounted care up to 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients will be considered as eligible for financial assistance up to 250% of the federal poverty level (FPL).

rules.label: Presumptive eligibility via CICP, CHP, or Medicaid enrollment
rules.quote: Applicant became CICP, CHP, or Medicaid-eligible and has balances prior to the effective date; Applicant is eligible for CICP, CHP, or Medicaid but incurs a non-covered service; Applicant is eligible for out-of-state Medicaid and SPRHC does not participate in that state's Medicaid program

rules.label: Amount charged limited to lesser of AGB or HDC co-payment
rules.quote: Patients who are eligible for financial assistance will pay the lesser of AGB or the co-payment amount per the HDC guidelines.

rules.label: Emergency/medically necessary care not charged more than AGB
rules.quote: In no event shall the reduced rate charged to patients eligible for financial assistance for emergency care or medically necessary services be greater than the AGB for such services.

rules.label: Non-emergency/non-medically-necessary care not charged more than gross charges
rules.quote: With respect to medical care provided other than emergency care and medically necessary services, patients eligible for financial assistance shall not be charged more than gross charges for such care.

notes: Policy references Colorado Hospital Discounted Care (HDC) and Colorado Indigent Care Program (CICP) Operations Manual FY 2022-23 for detailed eligibility criteria, screening process (Articles III and IV), and appeal process (Article XI).
HDC uses household income calculated per HDC §5.03 compared to FPL; discount based on Amounts Generally Billed (AGB) calculated annually via look-back method per 501(r).
HCHD will not bill patient balances to those who qualify for CICP or HDC; balances adjusted to internal financial assistance program.

HCHD makes reasonable efforts to determine eligibility before extraordinary collection actions per 501(r)(6); separate Patient Collections Policy defines extraordinary collection actions and notification periods.
If patient does not qualify for public programs and is uninsured, Self-Pay Discount policy applies.

Emergency care provided without discrimination per EMTALA; no pre-payment or collection activities in Emergency Center that could interfere with screening/stabilizing treatment of an emergency medical condition.
Providers list (Appendix B) specifies which providers delivering emergency/medically necessary care in HCHD facilities are covered by this policy.
Applicants will not be denied financial assistance based on failure to provide information/documentation not explicitly required by Policy or Application (HDC §1.01).
Determination of eligibility must be completed within 14 days of receipt of all required documentation (HDC §5.05).
Patients determined eligible shall not receive future bills for previously provided services based on undiscounted gross charges.
Policy overrides Self-Pay Discounts Policy for patients to whom it applies.
Hospital assists patients with applying for Medicaid, HDC, or CICP coverage; patients expected to cooperate.
CICP and HDC qualified patients issued laminated cards with effective dates.

rules.label: Financial Assistance Program up to 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients will be considered as eligible for financial assistance up to 250% of the federal poverty level (FPL).

rules.label: Amounts generally billed cap
rules.quote: In no event shall the reduced rate charged to patients eligible for financial assistance for emergency care or medically necessary services be greater than the AGB for such services.

notes: Eligibility also includes specific situations: applicant became CICP, CHP, or Medicaid-eligible and has balances prior to the effective date; applicant is eligible for CICP, CHP, or Medicaid but incurs a non-covered service; applicant is eligible for out-of-state Medicaid and SPRHC does not participate in that state’s Medicaid program; applicant has a mental incapacity and is unable to complete the Application; or patient is deceased and left no estate.
Determination must be completed within 14 days of receipt of all required documentation (HDC §5.05).
The discount is based on the amounts generally billed (AGB). AGB is determined annually and is based on the Look-back method as described in Section 501(r) of the Code and the regulations thereunder.
HCHD will not bill patient balances to those who qualify for CICP or HDC. Patient balances will be adjusted to the hospital’s internal financial assistance program.

HCHD shall make reasonable efforts to determine whether an individual is eligible for financial assistance before engaging in any 'extraordinary collection actions' as such term is defined in Section 50 I (r)(6) of the Code.
Self-Pay Discount policy applies if patient does not qualify for public programs and does not have insurance.
Policy overrides Self-Pay Discounts Policy when it applies to a specific patient.

Application of this policy to any individual patient is contingent upon satisfactory completion of the Financial Assistance Application with all necessary documentation. Any patient who refuses to satisfactorily complete the financial assistance application including the supporting documentation is not eligible for financial assistance under this policy (provided the patient has received the notifications required by the proposed regulations under Section 501 (r)).
